tex_content.label: corI.11.5
tex_content.html: For every $\epsilon >0$ there is $A<\infty $ such that any sequence of nonnegatively curved flows satisfying: $B(x_k,r_k)$ compactly contained at time zero; $\frac12R\leq R(x_k,0)=Q_k$ on the ball and time interval; $t_kQ_k\to -\infty $; and $r_k^2Q_k\to \infty $, obeys \[ \vol (B(x_k,AQ_k^{-1/2}))\leq \epsilon (AQ_k^{-1/2})^n \] for all large $k$.
